profile.summary: IVLIU is a Junior-level JavaScript developer with demonstrated expertise in the Axios HTTP client library, focusing on API configuration, error handling, and asynchronous programming patterns. Their contributions primarily involve extending and customizing Axios functionality, indicating proficiency in modern JavaScript practices and promise-based asynchronous workflows. While their contributions are limited to a single library (Axios), they show strong understanding of HTTP request handling, dynamic configuration, and user-facing error messaging. There is no evidence of contributions to frontend frameworks (React/Vue/Angular) or backend frameworks (Node.js/Express), nor is there clear involvement with testing, TypeScript, or build tools. The developer's experience appears focused on library-level JavaScript development rather than full-stack or framework-specific work.
